description: Li₃Na₃Al₂F₁₂ crystallizes in the cubic Ia̅3d space group. Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent F atoms. There are four shorter (2.34 Å) and four longer (2.48 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Li is bonded to four equivalent F atoms to form LiF₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. All Li-F bond lengths are 1.82 Å. Al is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LiF₄ tetrahedra. All Al-F bond lengths are 1.81 Å. F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, and one Al atom.
